oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH_ERRORS on /v1/generate (hosted). 80% 5xx for the last 4m. Page routed to eng-oncall primary. Incident runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/high-errors

Alex Nguyen: i'm primary for the evening but heads-up i'm on a train in 20m. can someone confirm secondary coverage if this escalates?

Morgan Rivera: i can be secondary. i'm remote but on laptop — can cover. @Alex Nguyen what's the current mitigation in the runbook?

Alex Nguyen: runbook first step is to check model pool saturation and fallbacks. also check routing policy — sometimes a bad model variant causes 5xx. run `scripts/check-serving.sh` and look at error rates in grafana.

Sanjay Patel: i'm looking at logs now. tail from the ingress: ```
2026-03-14T01:07:11Z ERR request_id=abc123 model=redwood-7b variant=q8 error=oom
2026-03-14T01:07:12Z ERR request_id=def456 model=redwood-7b variant=q8 error=kv_cache_mismatch
```
looks noisy for variant q8 on a subset of instances.

Lia Chen: thanks @Sanjay — could be a bad quantization rollout. any canary/rollout in the last 30m? deploy-bot: recent deploys -> canary: redwood-7b-q8 @ 00:50 UTC (30% traffic).

Alex Nguyen: ok that matches. quick plan: 1) reduce canary to 0% for redwood-7b-q8 2) fail open to previous variant redwood-7b-fp16 3) monitor 5xx drop 4) if stable, run a rollback of canary config.

Morgan Rivera: can you drop canary, @Alex? otherwise i can. I need to step into a call at 01:10 so if it persists ping me.

Alex Nguyen: i'm on mobile but can run the routing revert now. running: ```bash
# lower canary
redwoodctl traffic update --model redwood-7b-q8 --percent 0 --env hosted
# force fallback
redwoodctl routing set --route /v1/generate --fallback redwood-7b-fp16
```

Alex Nguyen: sent both commands. deploy-bot: traffic update accepted. routing change applied.

Sanjay Patel: error rate dropping in grafana — 5xx from 78% -> 22% in 90s. still some noise but way better.

Lia Chen: creating a short incident thread in incidents with impact note. Customer impact: intermittent errors for hosted text generation customers from 00:50–01:09 UTC (approx). cc billing/ps for any escalations.

Morgan Rivera: thanks. i'm secondary until 02:00 so i'll keep pager open. @Alex go safe, call away. if errors spike again, i'll promote to primary in rotation and follow runbook.

Alex Nguyen: appreciated. annotating handoff in rotation schedule: i'll mark myself as 'stepping out' until 02:30 and set Morgan as primary in Ops calendar.

oncall-bot: rotation update: Alex Nguyen -> stepping out 01:10-02:30, Morgan Rivera promoted to primary for eng-oncall. Link: https://redwood-internal/oncall/schedule

Sanjay Patel: continuing to watch logs. small subset still shows kv_cache_mismatch but it's tied to a handful of instances (ip 10.8.3.*). i'm going to cordon those boxes from the pool and trigger a graceful drain. running: `redwood-ops cordon --instances 10.8.3.21,10.8.3.22`

Lia Chen: thanks. make sure to add the instance ids to the incident ticket and note the drain ETA. I'll prepare an outbound status update if we get to external notice.

Alex Nguyen: back briefly — if Morgan needs to escalate to SRE leader, ping @sre-lead and include the log sample, runbook id, and current mitigation steps.

Morgan Rivera: noted. i'll update the incident ticket and keep slack thread as primary comms. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Sanjay Patel: instances cordoned, drain started. ETA 4m. will report back.

oncall-bot: incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. 5xx rate below threshold for 10m. Incident ticket: INC-2026-314 (internal).

Lia Chen: adding post-incident follow-ups: - postmortem owner: Morgan Rivera - action: add automatic rollback trigger for canary qos failures - action: add metric alert on kv_cache_mismatch

Morgan Rivera: I'll own the postmortem and schedule a 30m blameless review tomorrow. I'll also confirm rotation calendar reflects the temporary promotion.

Alex Nguyen: thanks team — leaving for call now. Morgan you have the pager.

Morgan Rivera: confirmed. primary oncall for the rest of the shift. last_message_ts: 1767004120
